method: Same-symptom rule: a later user-visible report of the same observable failure (root cause may differ) or a further attempt/reopen within 14 days after the acceptance claim, searched across thread titles/original requests, user messages, checkpoints, coordination messages, Beads issues and interactions.jsonl reopens, and commits. Acceptance timestamp = the attempt's completion report (finished/deployment checkpoint). Evidence types limited to: tests, live check, user confirmation, activation/install verified (includes plugin refresh verification), none.

records.title: Investigate empty Codex thread
records.eligibility_reason: Asks what caused a "failed to read thread ... rollout is empty" error shown in RF; user then asked for root-cause fix.
records.notes: First turn was diagnosis only; fix requested at 19:49:03Z. Acceptance = checkpoint 185 (Bead agent-coord-zjr closed 20:03:12Z). Plugins refreshed and three fresh installed sessions recovered; main UI restart queued behind idle watcher. No empty-rollout/failed-to-read-thread report found in 14 days.
